tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for all text.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, map card, side panel, menus, inputs.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: table header row, loading skeleton, map sea, segmented control track.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, dropdowns, chips, checkboxes). 3:1 or more on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and note-bg. Also the double rule under the header.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: source lines, captions, axis labels, metadata. 5:1 or more on every paper and on note-bg.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and borders of disabled controls only (exempt from contrast minimums; always paired with a not-allowed cursor and aria-disabled).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ink navy. Primary buttons, links, selected segment, logo ink, active menu item.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons and selected states.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected chips and the hovered table row.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ochre. Kickers (section labels), the year marker in tables, the focus ring. Never a data colour, never 'good' or 'bad'.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 4.8:1 or more on every paper in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text, underlined.

tokens.name: note-bg
tokens.usage: Notice (caveat) background.

tokens.name: est-bg
tokens.usage: Status tag Estimate: fill.

tokens.name: est-ink
tokens.usage: Status tag Estimate: text and glyph, on est-bg.

tokens.name: proj-bg
tokens.usage: Status tag Projection: fill.

tokens.name: proj-ink
tokens.usage: Status tag Projection: text and glyph, on proj-bg.

tokens.name: prelim-bg
tokens.usage: Status tag Preliminary: fill.

tokens.name: prelim-ink
tokens.usage: Status tag Preliminary: text and glyph, on prelim-bg.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icon in a chart's error state, on paper-raised or error-bg. A UI state only, never a data colour.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Error state panel fill.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Map and chart tooltip fill (inverted).

tokens.name: tooltip-ink
tokens.usage: Tooltip primary text, on tooltip-bg.

tokens.name: tooltip-muted
tokens.usage: Tooltip source line and labels, on tooltip-bg.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the phone menu's edges and the bottom sheet.

tokens.name: map-nodata
tokens.usage: Map fill: no data. Legend label 'No data'.

tokens.name: map-withheld
tokens.usage: Map hatch lines over map-nodata: value withheld by the source (for example USGS 'W'). Legend label 'Withheld by source'.

tokens.name: map-border
tokens.usage: Country borders on the map (gaps, not lines).

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential step 1 (lowest bin). Light: palest; dark: dimmest, so high values stand out in both themes. Shares, amounts, counts.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential step 2. Shares, amounts, counts.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential step 3. Shares, amounts, counts.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential step 4. Shares, amounts, counts.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential step 5 (highest bin). Shares, amounts, counts.

tokens.name: div-1
tokens.usage: Diverging 1: most import-dependent (imports cover most of use). Brown. Same values in both themes.

tokens.name: div-2
tokens.usage: Diverging 2: import-dependent. Same values in both themes.

tokens.name: div-3
tokens.usage: Diverging 3: slightly import-dependent. Same values in both themes.

tokens.name: div-4
tokens.usage: Diverging 4: neutral middle, roughly self-sufficient. Grey, no hue. Same values in both themes.

tokens.name: div-5
tokens.usage: Diverging 5: small net exporter. Same values in both themes.

tokens.name: div-6
tokens.usage: Diverging 6: net exporter. Same values in both themes.

tokens.name: div-7
tokens.usage: Diverging 7: largest net exporters. Teal. Same values in both themes.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1 (blue). Chart lines and series, assigned in this order and never cycled; a ninth series folds into Other. Always with a direct label or legend.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2 (olive). Chart lines and series, assigned in this order and never cycled; a ninth series folds into Other. Always with a direct label or legend.

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3 (plum). Chart lines and series, assigned in this order and never cycled; a ninth series folds into Other. Always with a direct label or legend.

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4 (ochre). Chart lines and series, assigned in this order and never cycled; a ninth series folds into Other. Always with a direct label or legend.

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5 (teal). Chart lines and series, assigned in this order and never cycled; a ninth series folds into Other. Always with a direct label or legend.

tokens.name: cat-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6 (rust). Chart lines and series, assigned in this order and never cycled; a ninth series folds into Other. Always with a direct label or legend.

tokens.name: cat-7
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 7 (sky). Chart lines and series, assigned in this order and never cycled; a ninth series folds into Other. Always with a direct label or legend.

tokens.name: cat-8
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 8 (rose). Chart lines and series, assigned in this order and never cycled; a ninth series folds into Other. Always with a direct label or legend.

styles.name: display-phone
styles.sample: Who depends on whom, for what

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: China mines 69% of the world's rare earths
styles.usage: Page title on map views, country and indicator pages. Phone: h1-phone.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: Indonesia mines 67% of the world's nickel
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, both sizes.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Key figure numbers. Lining, tabular figures. Phone: 44px.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Trade, energy, food, minerals, conflict and alliances, drawn from free official and research data.
styles.usage: Standfirst under a page title. Phone: 18/28.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Australia mined about a third of the world's lithium in 2025.
styles.usage: Running text, max 68 characters a line.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside running text and control labels.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Totals cover reporting countries only (38 of 54).
styles.usage: Notices, menus, panel text, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 · Updated 21 Oct 2026
styles.usage: Source lines, chart captions, footnotes. Never smaller.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers, table headers, legend titles, status tags (tags use sentence case).

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Tables and bar values: tabular, lining figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums), right-aligned.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a figure and its label; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page margin and gutter; card padding on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between components in a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on phone.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Above the footer.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default: cards, map card, panels, tiles, buttons. The atlas is square.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, dropdowns, status tags, bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Tooltip, bottom sheet top corners, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips and the year slider thumb only.

border.note: Borders, not shadows, separate things in the atlas.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Row and section hairlines (rule), control borders (rule-strong).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Selected tab underline, focus ring width, card top rule.

tokens.name: border-double
tokens.usage: The atlas double rule under the header and above the footer (border-style: double, ink).

grid.note: Desktop 1440: 12 columns inside a 1200px measure. Phone 390: 4 columns.

tokens.name: grid-max
tokens.usage: Content measure on desktop; margins grow beyond it (120px at 1440).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Content width inside grid-max once the gutters are off; header, footer and page content line up on it.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Desktop columns (from 1024px).

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Desktop column gutter.

tokens.name: grid-columns-phone
tokens.usage: Phone columns (under 760px).

tokens.name: grid-gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Phone gutter and side margin.

tokens.name: grid-text
tokens.usage: Max line length of running text.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Phone design width.

tokens.name: bp-compact
tokens.usage: Below this: phone header, stacked layouts, bottom sheet.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From this: 12-column grid, side panel.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Desktop design width.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: tooltip, dropdown list, menus, bottom sheet. Never on cards.
